result.stdout:
edifact — read and validate UN/EDIFACT against the published directories

Commands
  ingest <path-to-distribution>   Read a UNECE release directory into a compiled pack.
    --out <directory>             Where packs are written. Default: as resolved below.
    --syntax <directory>          Where the ISO 9735 definitions live.
    --no-strict                   Write a pack even if something went unaccounted for.
    --include-prose               Keep the directory's descriptive text. Writes to
                                  <pack-id>-prose, which .gitignore keeps out of the repo.

  ingest-guide <path-to-message>  Read an EANCOM Part II message guide into an overlay.
    --pack <pack-id>              Which release it is layered over. Required.
    --packs <directory>           Where packs live.
    --syntax <directory>          Where the ISO 9735 definitions live.
    --over <path>                 A guide this one will sit above. Repeatable. Needed
                                  where EANCOM restricts to codes the UN directory does
                                  not publish, which the Part III guide adds.
    --out <file>                  Write the guide there rather than to standard output.
    --id / --name / --edition     Override what the document calls itself.

  ingest-codes <path-to-part3>    Read the EANCOM Part III directory into the code set
                                  additions one message needs.
    --pack <pack-id>              Which release it is layered over. Required.
    --message <TYPE:V:R:A>        Which message to gather paths for. Required.
    --element <code>              A data element to cover. Repeatable. Default: the five
                                  the committed ORDERS guide covers.
    --for <path-to-part2>         Derive the element set from a Part II message folder's
                                  own UnavailableCode gaps, instead of --element.
    --packs <directory>           Where packs live.
    --syntax <directory>          Where the ISO 9735 definitions 
[truncated]
